purpose: Teach: そしたら/おまけに/ことし/おっしゃい/モテ/たいした/何かと/鮮やか

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ことしの新入生、何かと話題になってるよね。
lines.en: This year's first-years are getting talked about a lot, right?
lines.style: Bright, conspiratorial opening—leaning in slightly. Quick pace, energy forward. The tone of someone sharing something fun she's noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: モテそうな子、多いって聞いた。
lines.en: I heard there are quite a few who'd be pretty popular.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, unbothered surface. Steady pace. Eyes maybe drifting away slightly—he's heard the gossip but keeping his interest minimal.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: たいしたことないけど、ヒナさんの鮮やかな髪色、注目されてる。
lines.en: Nothing crazy, but Hina's hair color is really striking—people have definitely noticed.
lines.style: Knowing half-smile in the voice. Casual dismissal on the opening, then shifts to observational. Not mean—just seeing what everyone else sees.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おまけに、先生まで「綺麗な髪ね」っておっしゃい出してたぞ。
lines.en: And then even the teacher started saying 'what lovely hair,' you know?
lines.style: Quiet laugh underneath. Gentle mockery of the teacher's earnestness. Light, not sharp. The slight 'even the teacher' carries amusement at how obvious it all is.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そしたら、ハル先輩が彼女に絡みに行ってさ、爆笑だったよ。
lines.en: So then Haru-senpai decided to go chat her up, and it was hilarious.
lines.style: Laughing as she says it. Energy peaks on 'hilarious'—she's still finding the memory funny. Quick, delighted delivery. The warmth of watching someone else's mess.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お騒がせだな、相変わらず。
lines.en: He's always causing a fuss like that.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate resignation. Not exasperated—fond of the chaos. Warm close. The tone of someone used to forgiving someone they actually like.
